title: Lower bound for a cell index
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $N,T,t,r$ be nonnegative integers and $\tau$ a work-tape index. If $S=k(2T+1)+N+3$ is the configuration stride and $I$ is the cell index at time $t$, tape $\tau$, and position $r$, then $tS\le I$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Boolean symbols
$\tau$ is an element of the set of $k$ work-tape indices
